chapter.verse: Tu-in Adam in ama’ zi Evua luppih a, amah gai-in Kain nei a, “ Topa ’ huhna tawh mi khat ka ngah khin hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggampa Abel nei leuleu hi. Tu-in Abel in tuu kempa hi a, Kain in lo khopa ahi hi.
Tua hun sungin Kain in lei pan-a piang gah piakna Topa tungah paipih a,
Abel in a tuuhon tacilte leh a sa limcite paipih hi. Topa in Abel leh ama piakna thusim a,
ahih hangin Kain leh ama piakna thusim lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Kain heh mahmah a, a mai sia hi.
Topa in Kain tungah, “Bang hangin nang heh a, bang hangin na mai sia ahi hiam?

Lim takin hih lecin, nang hong kisang lo ding ahi hiam? Lim takin na hih kei leh nang hong hih nuamin mawhna in na kongah hong buk a, nang hong uk nuam hi. Ahih hangin nang in tua mawhna na zawh ding ahi hi,” ci hi.
Kain in a sanggampa Abel kiangah, “Gamlakah vak ni,” ci hi. Amaute gamlakah a om ciangun Kain in a sanggampa Abel gal bawlin that hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Kain tungah, “Na sanggampa Abel koi-ah om ahi hiam?” ci hi. Amah in, “Ka thei kei hi; keimah in ka sanggam a kempa ka hi hiam?” ci hi.
Topa in, “Nang’ bang hih na hi hiam? Na sanggampa’ sisan, leilak panin keitungah hong kiko hi.
Na khut sung panin na sanggampa’ sisan a hup dingin a kam a ka leitang tung panin tu-in nang hong kisamsiat hi.
Lo na khawh ciangin leitang in nang’ adingin an hong piangsak nawn lo ding hi; nang pen a galtai, leitunga a vakvai na hi ding hi,” ci hi.
Kain in Topa ’ tungah, “Keimah hong kidantahna in ka thuak zawh ding hi lo hi.

En in, tu ni-in nangmah in leitung panin kei nong notkhia a, nang’ kiang panin kei nong notkhia hi; kei pen a galtai, leitungah a vakvai ka hi ding a, kei hong mu peuhmah in hong that ding hi,” ci hi.

Tua ciangin Topa in ama kiangah, “Tua bang hi lo ding hi. Khatpeuh in Kain a thah leh tuapa' tungah a zah sagihin kithuk ding hi,” ci hi. Amah a tuak peuh in a thah khak loh nadingin Topa in Kain tungah ciamtehna khat koih hi.
Tua ciangin Topa ’ omna panin Kain pai khia a, Eden nisuahna lam Nod gamsungah teng hi.
Kain in ama’ zi luppih a, amah gai-in Enok nei hi; amah in khuapi khat sat a, tua khuapi min dingin ama' tapa' min Enok phuak hi.
Enok sung panin Irad suak hi; Irad in Mehujael’ pa hi, Mehujael in Methushael’ pa hi, Methushael in Lamek’ pa hi.
Lamek in zi nih nei hi; a khat’ min in Adah hi a, a dang khat’ min in Zillah ahi hi.
Adah in tapa Jabal nei hi; amah pen puanbukte' sungah tengin ganhing a neite’ pian’na pupi ahi hi.
A sanggampa’ min in Jubal hi; amah in laiza la sakna leh tamngai tumte khempeuh’ pian’na pupi ahi hi.
Zillah in Tubal-kain nei hi; amah in sumngo leh sik na-zat khempeuh a bawlte’ pian’na pupi ahi hi. Tubal-kain’ sanggamnu in Na-amah ahi hi.
Lamek in a zite' kiangah: “Adah leh Zillah aw, ka aw ngai un; Lamek’ zite aw, ka thugen ngai un: Kei hong liamsak manin mi khat, kei hong sat manin khanglai mi khat ka that khin hi.
Kain a kithah manin a sagih vei-in a kithukkik leh, Lamek a kithah manin sawmsagih mun sagih vei-in kithukkik taktak ding hi,” ci hi.

Adam in a zi luppih leuleu hi. Amah in tapa khat nei a, ama' min Seth ci hi, bang hang hiam cih leh, “Kain in amah that ahih manin Abel’ tangin naupang khat Pasian in kei’ adingin hong sehsak hi,” amah in ci hi.
Seth in zong tapa khat nei a, ama min Enosh ci hi. Tua hun-a kipanin mite in Topa bia-in a min lawh ding kipan uh hi.
